name: Chat AgentX Widget
author: nedhaf

sections.description:
ChatAgentX Widget lets you embed your Chat AgentX agent on any WordPress page.
– Set a default Agent ID in Settings → Chat AgentX.
– Or use the shortcode [chatagentx agent_id=”YOUR_ID”].

External services

This plugin loads the Chat AgentX widget from an external service hosted at:

  • https://chatagentx.com/widget.js

The widget is provided by Chat AgentX and is used to display and run your AI chat agent on the site.

When the widget script is loaded, the following data is sent to the Chat AgentX servers as part of normal web requests:

  • The visitor’s IP address and browser/user agent.
  • The URL of the page where the widget is loaded.
  • Any messages that the visitor types/dictates into the chat widget, so that Chat AgentX can generate responses.
  • Any additional data you configure to send from your Chat AgentX account (for example, context about your site or business).

Use of this service requires a Chat AgentX account and is subject to Chat AgentX’s own terms and privacy policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://chatagentx.com/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://chatagentx.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chat-agentx-widget folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Chat AgentX, enter your Agent ID, and optionally enable “Load on all pages”.
  4. Alternatively, use the shortcode [chatagentx agent_id="YOUR_ID"] in any post or page.
